body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> BenQ displayed ''FP785’, an innovatively designed LCD monitor by a fashion designer ''Roberto Cavalli'' at KES 2006. This model reveals a design concept of BenQ under the theme of ''harmony of beauty and lifestyle between the East and the West''.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
